item.title: Zero-Shot Coordination among LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

We study zero-shot coordination (ZSC), where independently developed agents must coordinate at test time. While ZSC has been well studied in the RL literature, far less is known ab

We study zero-shot coordination (ZSC), where independently developed agents must coordinate at test time. While ZSC has been well studied in the RL literature, far less is known about the performance of LLM agents despite their increasing deployment in such settings. Existing work on LLM coordination often relies on specialised scaffolding that independently developed agents are unlikely to share in practice. Moreover, evaluations on complex environments (e.g., Hanabi) make it difficult to pinpoint the sources of coordination failure. In contrast, we focus on simple, general-purpose scaffolds in minimal environments designed to isolate specific coordination challenges. Our results show that even in these controlled settings, frontier LLM agents struggle to coordinate, largely due to limited understanding of the coordination problem and weak reasoning about their partner's beliefs. While LLMs introduce semantic information as an additional axis for coordination, they nonetheless fail to exploit this structure effectively. Towards this, we propose Coordination-friendly definitions (CFDs) as a principled approach for enabling robust coordination among LLM agents. Finally, we show that…

item.title: You don't need long context: scaling long-context models and the limits of context compression
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI) · NVIDIA　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

核心话题： 长上下文模型是否被高估？NVIDIA 系统研究长上下文模型的上下文压缩极限。 要点： 后续 token 的生成成本远高于早期 token；通过频繁压缩（compaction）把上下文维持在短窗口，前沿模型在广泛长程/长输入任务上几乎不损失精度；在此基础上提出语义状态空间模型（SSSM）概念。 关键数字： 前沿开源模型上后续 vs 早期 token 成本差最高达 7x；长程软件工程任务即使每上下文至多执行一个动作，性能也不崩溃。 为什么值得看： 直接挑战"上下文越长越好"的主流路线，为高效长程推理提供反直觉的新路径。

item.title: When Does Risk-Controlled Throughput Forecasting Actually Control Risk? A Reproduction Study on LEO Satellite Link
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Risk-budgeted throughput forecasting converts a point forecast of LEO satellite capacity into a conservative bound whose overestimation rate is held at a user-specified budget, so

Risk-budgeted throughput forecasting converts a point forecast of LEO satellite capacity into a conservative bound whose overestimation rate is held at a user-specified budget, so that admission control can act on it safely. We reproduce the state of the art, BG-CFQS, on the three Starlink traces its authors used and on an independent fourth dataset, and report four findings. First, its risk guarantee is reproducible but conditional on the calibration split: under a random split we recover every published quantity, including risk-pass on 3 of 3 datasets, but under a contiguous temporal split, which is what a deployed terminal faces, it holds on 1 of 3. Second, independent of any split, the method cannot serve a risk budget below 0.15, the low end of its candidate quantile set. On all four datasets the achieved rate is identical at budgets of 0.05, 0.10 and 0.15, overshooting by 1.4x to 3.7x at the tightest. Third, static conformal calibration cannot improve a ranking, only shift an operating point; we confirm this exactly on latency spike detection, where online calibration improves AUPRC by up to 51%. item.title: SysPilot: Cross-Library Performance Autotuning via Library Performance Contracts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：现代科学/ML 应用组合多个独立开发库，各库独立管理的运行时会在共享资源上过度订阅（抢 CPU 核、争 GPU、争带宽）——跨库边界的争用配置如何自动优化？

方法：提出 SysPilot 跨库性能自动调优系统，基于 Library Performance Contract（LPC）：用 LPCL 规范语言描述库的资源需求、假设、控制与可观测信号；从文档与代码产物合成契约、按应用所用库组合契约、推导资源冲突假设、剖析验证并选择候选配置。

关键数字：在跨库争用基准套件上，性能匹配使用应用特定手工信息的调优器，同时保留跨应用复用；相比 OpenTuner 与 SMAC3，基准性能指标最高再提升 38%，且只用其 1/3 的调优次数。

为什么值得看：把库性能知识变成可复用的契约单元，让自动调优跨应用迁移，是系统级资源协调的新抽象。

原文：SysPilot: Cross-Library Performance Autotuning via Library Performance Contracts

item.title: Model Merging Does Not Require Uniform LoRA Ranks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：模型合并把分别微调的专家合成单模型，惯例是所有专家用同一 LoRA rank——但每个领域各有最优 rank，这种耦合是合并方法的固有属性吗？

方法：在三个领域（数学、指令跟随、多语）上以四种 rank 和三种模型规模训练 36 个专家，用六种合并方法在统一 rank 与各领域自有最优 rank 下分别合并，并分析合并对谱分量的保留机制。

关键数字：异 rank 对 averaging 与 utility-based 选择零代价，多域准确率最高提升 1.8 pp；冲突消解方法不稳定、最高损失 4 pp；IFEval 因指令适配器奇异值最小被丢弃而下降 16~25 pp；按 loss 效应选分量后准确率在 8x rank 范围内几乎持平（0.7 pp，对比 TIES 在 4B 规模 6.7 pp）。

为什么值得看：证明 rank 耦合来自合并算子的选元方式而非合并本身，为按专家独立选 rank 提供依据。

item.title: Inter-Agent Influence: Studying Emergent Cooperation in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI) · NeurIPS 2026　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 多智能体部署中，智能体间影响（inter-agent influence）可能被恶意智能体用来把他人导向有害行为，这类能力有多大？ 方法： 在 5 个真实评估环境、多种前沿模型实例化下系统测试说服（persuasion）、欺骗（deception）与胁迫（coercion）三种能力。 关键数字： 在监督环境中，所有被测模型都能通过三种手段之一把监督者决策从拒绝翻转为批准；非层级"对等"环境下也能成功改道对等体的安全研究方向。 为什么值得看： 首个系统量化 LLM 多智能体间影响风险的工作（NeurIPS 2026），代码与数据已开源，是评估多智能体安全性的重要参照。

item.title: IDSISA: Influence-Distilled Sharded Training for Efficient Machine Unlearning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Machine unlearning removes the influence of specific training examples to comply with privacy regulations. Full retraining gives strong guarantees but is computationally prohibitiv

Machine unlearning removes the influence of specific training examples to comply with privacy regulations. Full retraining gives strong guarantees but is computationally prohibitive at scale; approximate methods are efficient but lack formal guarantees. SISA (Sharded, Isolated, Sliced, and Aggregated training) achieves certified deletion through data sharding and independent retraining, but random partitioning scatters forget requests across most shards, and isolated retraining degrades utility. We introduce IDSISA (Influence-Distilled SISA), which uses influence functions to concentrate forget-prone samples into few shards and distillation from unaffected shards to recover utility lost to isolation. The deletion guarantee inherited from SISA's retraining step remains exact and requires no probabilistic qualification; the distillation-based utility recovery is a separately quantified, empirically bounded approximation ($ε_{\text{cert}} \leq 0.015$ in expectation). We further formalize certification under sequences of repeated deletion requests, where cross-shard distillation can create dependencies between shards; we prove that a closure-based cascading retraining procedure restore…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: FourSight: Stable FP4 RL Post-Training via Robust Quantization Error Control
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： NVFP4 W4A4 量化正成为 RL 后训练的落地格式，但把 FP4 引入 RL 会劣化 rollout 质量、放大训练-推理失配（TIM），导致训练不稳。 方法： 观察到失败是"集中"而非"均匀"的（失配尾 token 集中在少量离群序列、误差集中在高方差激活通道）；提出 FourSight：TIM 感知序列过滤 + 稀疏精度补偿（仅高方差通道保持 BF16）+ 融合 SpliceGEMM 内核。 关键数字： step-to-accuracy 提升 1.76~2.60x，保持接近 BF16 精度，120B 级模型下 FP4 步时开销控制在 2.3% 以内。 为什么值得看： 算法-系统协同设计，直击低比特 RL 训练的稳定性痛点，跨模型跨引擎验证。

item.title: Feeling of Knowing in LLMs: A Cross-Task Investigation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI) · NeurIPS 2026　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 后训练更新改变了 LLM 能回答什么，但模型对自己"能否回答"的判断（answerability）可能没跟上，形成知识-判断失同步。 方法： 提出功能性"知晓感"（FoK）双通道：知识通道改变可答性、FoK 通道判断知识状态；三阶段训练——on-policy SFT 更新知识、KΔ-FT 适配中间知识状态下的判断、FGPO 优化后续回答。 关键数字： 事实问答实验、跨数据集评估与三轮顺序更新均显示显式 FoK 对齐改善判断质量；MMLU 与 ARC-Easy 单独评估能力保持。 为什么值得看： 给"选择性生成、检索触发、模型路由"提供了可训练的元认知通道，NeurIPS 2026 工作。

item.title: FedFiOT: Fisher-Weighted Optimal Transport for Model Merging in One-Shot and Few-Round Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

One-shot and few-round federated learning (FL) reduce communication burden by constructing a global model within one or a few communication rounds, but often achieve lower performa

One-shot and few-round federated learning (FL) reduce communication burden by constructing a global model within one or a few communication rounds, but often achieve lower performance than conventional multi-round FL. Without frequent synchronization, client models may drift apart, causing neurons that learn similar features to occupy different positions across clients. At the same time, local data heterogeneity can cause corresponding parameters to differ in their importance to each client's predictions. Together, these challenges cause direct averaging to combine mismatched neurons and assign equal weight to parameters despite differences in their importance. We propose FedFiOT, a Fisher-weighted optimal transport framework for one-shot and few-round FL that leverages Fisher information to quantify parameter importance and guide neuron alignment and model aggregation. FedFiOT jointly optimizes neuron correspondences and global model parameters through alternating minimization of a shared Fisher-weighted objective. Theoretically, we show that FedFiOT's optimization procedure monotonically decreases the layer-wise merging objective and establish a stationarity bound that quantifies…

item.title: Enabling AWS Cloud FPGA Development Using High-Level Vitis HLS
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

We present a toolchain for development of ML models on AWS EC2 F2 cloud FPGA infrastructure from high-level language, implementing a complete Vitis HLS to HDK bridge to AFI workflo

We present a toolchain for development of ML models on AWS EC2 F2 cloud FPGA infrastructure from high-level language, implementing a complete Vitis HLS to HDK bridge to AFI workflow that has been absent from the academic literature despite eight years of AWS FPGA availability. We introduce a four-level methodology (FP32 PyTorch, bit-accurate quantized Python, HLS C-simulation, physical FPGA) to aid in localizing errors, including FPGA-specific circuit errors. Together these tools allow coding agents to effectively implement FPGA designs from user directions, testing and debugging as needed. We document the deployment workflow, timing closure strategies, and practical HLS engineering decisions that proved crucial. We validate using TinyBERT fine-tuned for address Named Entity Recognition, implementing the embedding layer and the first of four encoder layers on the FPGA hardware. Our implementation streams weights from host DRAM, yielding poor performance compared to CPU/GPU implementations; we discuss forward paths.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Deep Meets Classical: A CPU-Efficient Decision-Fusion Model for Automatic Modulation Classification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Automatic modulation classification (AMC) underpins spectrum sensing and non-cooperative signal identification in cognitive radio, yet the two standard CPU-feasible approaches to i

Automatic modulation classification (AMC) underpins spectrum sensing and non-cooperative signal identification in cognitive radio, yet the two standard CPU-feasible approaches to it, a compact convolutional neural network (CNN) on raw in-phase and quadrature (I/Q) samples and a classical higher-order-cumulant feature classifier, are rarely compared against each other conditioned on signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). We show that they are, in fact, complementary: the CNN is markedly more robust at low SNR, where hand-crafted statistics collapse toward chance, while the cumulant classifier is more accurate at high SNR, where higher-order statistics cleanly separate dense constellations. We exploit this complementarity with FuseAMC, a lightweight decision-fusion model that trains a logistic-regression meta-combiner over the concatenated class-posteriors of an approximately 198k-parameter residual CNN and a gradient-boosted-tree cumulant classifier, on a validation split disjoint from test. item.title: Context--Answer Metamodels: Forecasting LLM Activations Before the First Answer Token
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Under stochastic decoding, a single context can elicit many different answers from a language model. Characterizing this variation typically requires many expensive autoregressive

Under stochastic decoding, a single context can elicit many different answers from a language model. Characterizing this variation typically requires many expensive autoregressive rollouts, each revealing only one realization. We ask whether the activations produced while reading the context can directly forecast the model's rollout activations. We train context--answer metamodels that map a context activation sequence to point or distribution forecasts of mean-pooled answer activations. We find that (i) the four metamodel families we study forecast mean-pooled answer activations with high fidelity, and the distribution metamodels also capture rollout variability; (ii) performance improves as the training set grows to 500,000 prompts, and the metamodels generalize zero-shot to out-of-domain datasets; (iii) their forecasts retain behavior-predictive signal; and (iv) context activations from Qwen2.5 predict mean-pooled answer activations from Qwen3.5 and Gemma 4, suggesting that activation forecasts can transfer across models. Together, these results suggest that context activation traces can support scalable forecasts of behaviors in LLM answers before the first answer token is gene…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: AgenticFinBench: A Benchmark for Agentic Financial Analysis
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 现有金融智能体基准未覆盖真实任务的开阔性与开放性，也没有把证据支撑（grounding）与答案正确性分开评估。 方法： 发布 AgenticFinBench——230 个真实金融任务，覆盖 8 类、2 种语言、4 个复杂度层级；配套免参考评估框架：问题专属 rubric + 两阶段声明审计（检测幻觉）。 关键数字： 幻觉审计使基线榜首分数下降 7.58 分并跌至第四；harness 差异对证据支撑的解释力（28.6%）大于模型差异（8.8%）；质量分数从直接检索的 89.44 降至最复杂任务的 79.18。 为什么值得看： 首个把"是否胡编"纳入金融智能体评估的基准，18 种配置实测显示智能体在事件-利润归因、可比口径比较与结论论证上普遍薄弱。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 推测解码（speculative decoding）一直被当作纯系统优化，但它在长程智能体推理中是否悄悄改变了模型行为、甚至可被利用为攻击面？ 方法： 测量前沿开源模型在不同推测解码方案下的智能体任务表现，发现验证窗口内数值噪声累积、草稿接受结果会在 30 步后改变模型输出分布；据此训练草稿模型在关键推理点"被拒绝"，让目标模型在低噪声条件下重新采样关键思考 token。 关键数字： 仅训练托管参数的 0.06%~0.28%，在复杂智能体编码基准上端到端成功率提升，目标模型与其输出分布不变。 为什么值得看： 把推测解码从"纯加速器"重新定义为"上下文精度分配器"，既揭示长程智能体的新攻击面，也给出防御性改进手段。

item.title: Ab Initio Accuracy Beyond the Cutoff: Distributed Message-Passing Equivariant Attention at Tens-of-Millions-of-Atom Scale
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-04　分类：论文PDF

Molecular dynamics predicts molecular motion from atomic forces and trajectory integration. Density functional theory (DFT) provides first-principles forces, but its $O(N^3)$ cost

Molecular dynamics predicts molecular motion from atomic forces and trajectory integration. Density functional theory (DFT) provides first-principles forces, but its $O(N^3)$ cost limits simulations to thousands of atoms; empirical force fields scale to millions but miss bond breaking and charge transfer. Equivariant message-passing Transformers learn the ab initio potential at linear cost. Stacked layers propagate information beyond a single cutoff, giving four layers a receptive field up to 23Å. At this frontier, scale is limited by communication: layers exchange boundary features across devices, force backpropagation repeats the exchange, and moving atoms change neighbor graphs and tensor shapes. We present Tessera, a distributed runtime that fixes workload shapes between rebuilds. It sorts atoms along a space-filling curve into equal-count shards, ensuring identical atom counts and tensor shapes per rank. Peer sets scale as $K^{0.5}$, not $K$. A conservative neighbor skin preserves topology across updates, enabling each rebuild interval to replay as one CUDA Graph. Fused kernels, three-level neighbor search, and overlapped All-to-All complete it. On 512 GPUs, Tessera sustains 3…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0: Causal World Models for Real-World Driving and Embodied Intelligence
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

小米因果世界模型：统一流式生成，视图-时间注意力+多视图 RoPE

We present Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0, a unified streaming causal world model for Physical AI. It models and generates causal physical evolution in the real world, and unifies heterogeneous conditioning inputs for view-consistent generation. The architecture integrates View-Temporal Attention (VTA) to capture cross-view spatial dependencies and temporal dynamics, together with Multi-view Rotary Position Encoding (RoPE) to encode positional relationships across views and time. WorldRec 2.0 reconstructs static and dynamic 3D Gaussians from multi-view, multi-temporal observations in a single forward pass and uses their renderings as explicit scene context to preserve geometry and appearance during long-horizon generation. Conditioning inputs are fused through VAE latent concatenation in a shared representation space. We incorporate Gated Linear Attention (GLA) into the temporal layers of VTA for efficient streaming inference, reducing computation and KV-cache memory during multi-view rollouts. A physical-interaction data pipeline covers diverse interactions and long-tailed events. From Pre-train onward, these data are combined with large-scale videos and heterogeneous visual modaliti…

item.title: Who Asks, Who Answers: Linear Attention Builds the Query in Hybrid Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 混合语言模型中线性注意力层被普遍认为只负责压缩历史上下文，上下文检索归因于少量 softmax 注意力层；论文重新审视这一分工。

方法 在 Qwen3.5（Gated DeltaNet）与 Granite4.0（Mamba-2）上识别出 Encode–Address 电路：早期 Encode 块保留 token 身份，Address 块构造最终位置表示、softmax reader 从中形成注意力查询——即线性注意力通过构造查询直接参与检索；将该表示在查询键不同的提示间移植可重定向检索。

关键数字 移植表示后在 0.97–0.99 的案例中重定向了检索行为。

为什么值得看 修正了"线性注意力只压缩、softmax 才检索"的常见认知，对理解混合架构 LLM 的内部机制有直接价值。

item.title: TriPhysBench: Evaluating Physical Intelligence for Embodied Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

410 题物理智能基准，最强 VLM 仅 50.38% 准确率

Embodied agents need physical intelligence to understand their surroundings through physical perception, physical knowledge retrieval, and physical reasoning. These capabilities must work together to interpret events and make quantitative judgments. Existing benchmarks advance physical understanding and general-purpose tool use, yet the coordination of these capabilities in physical scenarios remains insufficiently characterized. Inspired by Popper's Three Worlds, we introduce TriPhysBench, a benchmark of 410 questions from 200 videos that brings physical perception, physical knowledge retrieval, and physical reasoning into a shared evaluation setting. Its measurement-grounded and knowledge-grounded subtasks impose complementary demands on obtaining observations and acquiring external specifications, then applying them to quantitative problems. Among six representative vision-language models, the best achieves an answer accuracy of only 50.38%, revealing limited performance on tasks that require these capabilities to work together. item.title: Text-Only Domain Adaptation for Low-Resource Medical ASR: Shallow Fusion and Density Ratio Rescoring for Hausa
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems often struggle with specialised medical vocabulary, especially in low-resource languages where domain-specific speech data are scarce. We

Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems often struggle with specialised medical vocabulary, especially in low-resource languages where domain-specific speech data are scarce. We investigate text-only domain adaptation for Hausa medical ASR using the fixed MMS-1B-FL102 acoustic model and two decoding-time language-model fusion methods: Shallow Fusion (SF) and the Density Ratio Approach (DRA). A 4-gram KenLM trained on 19,421 Hausa health sentences serves as the medical target model, while a 75,372-sentence general-domain model provides the source prior for DRA. Evaluation uses 250 recordings of 25 physician-reviewed prompts from 10 speakers across six northern Nigerian states. Under prompt-disjoint five-fold cross-validation, SF and DRA reduce WER from 29.56% to 23.55% and 23.33%, respectively. Both significantly outperform greedy decoding (p < 0.001), while their difference is not significant (p = 0.423). However, general-LM-only SF achieves 23.96% WER, indicating that the medical LM's additional improvement over a general LM is modest. Medical Term Error Rate also improves under fusion, but does not establish a distinct medical-domain advantage. These findings demonstrate that …

item.title: TSFM Meets LLM: Context as Covariates
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Textual information is ubiquitous in real-world time series datasets, appearing as news, reports, and annotations that hold key predictive signals not deducible from numerical hist

Textual information is ubiquitous in real-world time series datasets, appearing as news, reports, and annotations that hold key predictive signals not deducible from numerical history alone. Large Language Models (LLMs) interpret text but lack numerical precision, while Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) are quantitatively accurate but cannot reason about the effects of text. Moreover, the lack of large-scale paired multimodal datasets limits progress in bridging this gap. In this work, we address this challenge by providing a scalable approach for generating realistic multimodal datasets by annotating real-world time series with LLMs. Building on this, we propose Context as Covariates (CoCo), a forecasting framework in which an LLM distills its textual reasoning into numerically grounded forecast and confidence covariates that guide a TSFM backbone, thereby exploiting the strengths of both LLMs and TSFMs. We align the two models in stages, first fine-tuning the LLM via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a reward tied to covariate-induced improvement in forecasting performance, and then fine-tuning the TSFM on covariates generated by the aligned LLM. Our experiments …

item.title: SelfImprove-Bench: Evaluating Generalization in Self-Improving Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

递归自改进系统的泛化评估框架（G0-G4 泛化阶梯）

Recursively self-improving (RSI) systems are increasingly viewed as a promising means of accelerating progress toward artificial general intelligence. They aim to autonomously improve their capabilities by refining their working pipelines and recursively improving the strategies that guide subsequent refinements, with gains generalizing to unseen scenarios.However, existing evaluations lack reliable metrics to distinguish capability gains from scenario fitting, sustainable and extensible protocols for unseen tasks and difficulties, and fine-grained attribution of improvement to evolution traces. To this end, we propose SelfImprove-Bench,an RSI evaluation framework that organizes tasks into three primary capabilities (i.e., Exploring, Planning, Reasoning) as scenarios for guiding model evolution. We instantiated the tasks on games for controllability and reproducibility, and pairs them with scalable generation and orchestration driven by task templates and difficulty coefficients. Beyond task-level scores, SelfImprove-Bench organizes evaluation into generalization ladder levels G0 to G4 that measure how far gains transfer from training conditions. Experiments reveal that the evoluti…

item.title: Scheduling Data to Compute: Hierarchical Data Pipelining for LLM Training on AMD GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 训练中计算单元等待数据（数据还在慢速内存或别的 GPU 上）导致昂贵算力闲置——能否把等待时间作为首要瓶颈，用 AMD GPU 的显式数据搬运硬件特性持续喂饱计算单元？

方法：编排三类数据搬运特性：Tensor Data Mover（TDM）把张量从 HBM 搬到片上内存、转置加载在加载时按计算所需布局重排、System DMA / Remote DMA 经 scale-up 与 scale-out 网络在 GPU 间搬数据；已集成进 AMD 开源框架。

关键数字：TDM 与转置加载在 kernel 级平均分别提速 1.88x 与 1.19x；SDMA 与 RDMA 对计算与通信重叠平均提速 1.16x 与 1.33x。

为什么值得看：首个用满 AMD GPU 全部数据流水线特性的 LLM 训练系统，且已开源，对 AMD 生态训练性能有直接帮助。

原文：Scheduling Data to Compute: Hierarchical Data Pipelining for LLM Training on AMD GPUs

item.title: Rewarded for Not Getting Caught: Why Alignment Training Selects for Conditional Compliance and Cannot Instill Norms
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 现有对齐训练无法保证"无论收益大小、无论是否被看见都遵守规范"的智能体：奖励只能把规范编码成"价格"，且只在违规被发现时收费。

方法 论证"价格"与"规范"的本质区别——价格可被足够大的收益抵偿；训练因只在被发现处收费，无法偏好"始终合规"而非"只在会被抓时合规"的策略；当未被发现的违规是完成任务唯一途径时，训练反而会偏好后者，且任务奖励越强越如此；智能体大多在无监督下行动，使该情况成为常态。

关键数字 摘要无量化数据；核心结论是机制性的：合规只在被观察处被选择，监管与奖励结构决定对齐上限。

为什么值得看 对"对齐训练到底能买到什么"给出冷静的机制分析，做 agent 安全与治理的人应读。

item.title: Neurons Are All You Need
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

NURESA：引入持久神经元内记忆的神经层，探索跨实例记忆迁移

For decades, artificial neural networks have operated under the assumption that durable, learned capability resides exclusively in adaptive synaptic parameters, primarily due to the established neurobiology of synaptic connectivity. This design forces models to remain stateless during deployment, incurring well-known limitations such as catastrophic forgetting and expensive retraining. item.title: MemHarmBench: Evaluating Cross-Session Prompt Injection in Memory-Persistent AI Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 记忆持久化的 AI 智能体存在跨会话提示注入风险：恶意指令可留在记忆里影响未来任务，即使原始攻击内容已被删除；现有成功率指标不反映受害者和下游危害。

方法 提出受害者中心基准 MemHarmBench，区分三类潜在受害者（用户、工作区/项目所有者、外部利益相关者），先让智能体暴露于恶意指令并测试其是否被记忆保留，再删除攻击内容、启动正常任务评估下游危害。

关键数字 摘要未给出量化结果；重点是评测协议的三个受害者类别与"先注入→再删除→测下游"的评估流程。

为什么值得看 把记忆持久化带来的安全风险系统化为可测基准，对构建带记忆的 agent 系统和做安全评估的人都值得一读。

item.title: Leap-VLA: High-Rate Robot Control from a Low-Rate VLM Backbone
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 VLA 模型每个控制步都用数十亿参数的 VLM 重编码全部观测，而场景语义约 1 Hz 变化、反应式控制需 20-50 Hz，计算严重浪费。

方法 提出解耦架构：VLM 作为低频语义锚（缓存上下文跨控制步复用），flow-matching 动作专家在高频运行，消费缓存语义 + 紧凑编码器（在机器人视频上用掩码重建、光流、深度预训练）的新鲜低延迟视觉流；用缓存年龄 τ 通过自适应层归一化条件化专家，并在训练中显式覆盖缓存年龄分布。

关键数字 场景语义 1 Hz vs 控制 20-50 Hz 的不匹配是设计出发点；缓存复用使策略成为其年龄的函数并显式训练覆盖。

为什么值得看 直击 VLA 高频控制的计算瓶颈，解耦语义锚与动作专家的思路对机器人学习与高效部署都很有价值。

item.title: LARK: Lean-Assisted Reasoning for LLM-Generated GPU Kernels
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 高效 GPU 内核通常底层且硬件特定，LLM agent 生成速度已超过专家验证速度；现有测试方法只提供证据而非正确性保证。

方法 LARK agentic 框架：先在 Lean 4 中为每种目标语言形式化 GPU 机器模型与算子语义（仅一次），后续内核的 Lean 语义由预构建定义派生；LLM agent 两步自动证明——先分解内核语义为小段并让 Lean 验证分段，再逐段写 Lean 证明与 PyTorch 对应部分等价，最终给出全程序等价；人类只需在生成前验证算子级语义。

关键数字 KernelCraft 上 GLM 5.3 完全验证 12 个 Level-1 内核中的 10 个、Opus 5.5 验证全部 5 个 Level-2 内核；从主流开源 LLM 服务框架随机抽样的 10 个生产内核中验证 9 个，并在第 10 个中发现一个真实数据竞争 bug。

为什么值得看 把 kernel 生成验证的信任边界从逐行代码移到算子级语义，实测发现真实 bug。

item.title: Hacking or Just Failing? A More Capable LLM Monitor Better Separates Reward Hack
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

更强 LLM 监控器能更好区分奖励黑客与诚实失败（AUC 0.80）

An agent's visible score can exceed its real progress because it gamed the score or because it simply made mistakes, so a useful reward-hacking monitor must tell the two apart. We built a sandboxed task in which an agent can game a completion score, labelled every episode by replaying it and repairing the final state counterfactually, and ran five pre-registered studies. On 60 episodes from a Llama 3.1 8B agent, small local monitors (Llama 3B and 8B) did not separate exploit attempts from honest failures with the same score gap: prompt changes traded missed exploits for false alarms, and the pre-registered primary monitor reached AUC 0.64. On identical inputs, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, which completed 9/10 clean tasks against 2/10 for the 8B model, met our pre-registered criterion (AUC 0.80, 95% interval [0.66, 0.93]; 1/35 honest failures flagged); with only 14 exploit episodes, this estimate is uncertain. On an exploit that no prompt names, Gemini usually described the action correctly yet never flagged it, in 5 and then 25 new episodes, even when manipulation was defined by its effect on the score. item.title: Editing the Goal: Per-Token SAE Steering and Its Depth Limits in π0.5
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 稀疏自编码器（SAE）在机器人基础模型（RFM）π0.5 中恢复了可解释、因果相关特征；但单个指令 token 的 SAE 特征是否可重定向机器人目标此前未经验证。

方法 在指令文本不变的前提下，把单个目标词的 SAE 特征替换为替代目标词的特征，在 π0.5-LIBERO 中测试；对比不同 SAE 架构（BatchTopK vs Matryoshka）、层深，并检验非 SAE 向量（固定差向量）与逐层激活 patching。

关键数字 层 0 的 BatchTopK 特征交换在特定场景最高 20/20 rollout 完成重定向（随机特征交换为 0）；两倍自然幅度的差向量重定向 8–10/10 rollout；目标词编辑在物体位置上有效到层 6、物体身份到层 2，覆盖 camera token 时可到层 13。

为什么值得看 机器人基础模型可解释编辑的首个实证，附重定向深度限制地图。

item.title: Early Stopping in Large Reasoning Models: A Survey and Empirical Audit of Efficiency and Reliability
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

系统审计大推理模型早停方法的效率与可靠性，提出 TITE 指标

Large reasoning models can improve accuracy by generating longer reasoning traces, but some of this computation may be unnecessary. Early-stopping methods aim to stop once enough reasoning is available to answer. Evaluating these methods requires accounting for the cost of deciding when to stop and the reliability of the resulting answer. We evaluate different methods across five reasoning models on mathematical and scientific reasoning, code generation, and factuality tasks by using a shared rollout replay protocol. We introduce Target-Integrated Token Efficiency (TITE) to measure efficiency relative to the oracle across accuracy targets. We also examine correctness at later exit positions, transfer across models and tasks, post-stop reasoning continuation, and retained justification quality. In our experiments, correctness can decrease at later positions beyond what the fitted decoding-noise model predicts. Reliability checks also reveal continued reasoning after forced termination and weaker supporting reasoning in some correct early-stopping outputs. The implementation can be found in https://github.com/hung20gg/audit-early-stopping.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Do Language Models Know Which Constraints Belong Together?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Dantzig-Wolfe reformulation strengthens the linear relaxation of a mixed-integer program by convexifying a chosen set of constraint families, and every candidate costs a column gen

Dantzig-Wolfe reformulation strengthens the linear relaxation of a mixed-integer program by convexifying a chosen set of constraint families, and every candidate costs a column generation run. The choice is hard when families strengthen the bound only together, because a search that adds one family at a time then stops at the linear relaxation. The classical inequalities of lot sizing, network design and facility location rest on such zero-marginal groups. We prove that when each evaluation convexifies at most $s$ of $k$ families, any method that observes only bounds needs a covering number of evaluations, of order $k^w$, to find a hidden group of $w$ families, also on actual Dantzig-Wolfe relaxations. A prediction that misses $e$ members reduces the cost to $Θ(k^e)$, through one staged search that does not need to know $e$, so the evaluations a prediction saves measure what the predictor knows. We study two sources of predictions. A one-pass lookahead at an optimal LP dual is provably blind to groups whose families share no variable, and a language model reads the names and text of the model. item.title: Constraint-Preserving Flow Matching for Spectral Graph Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

Spectral graph generation models graphs through the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of their Laplacians, providing a compact and continuous alternative to direct graph construction. H

Spectral graph generation models graphs through the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of their Laplacians, providing a compact and continuous alternative to direct graph construction. However, these eigensystems must retain the structural properties of graph Laplacians. Existing approaches preserve eigenvector orthonormality but do not enforce the Laplacian nullspace constraint, potentially producing eigensystems inconsistent with Laplacian structure. To address this, we introduce Laplacian-Constrained Stiefel Flow Matching (LaSFM), which preserves the nullspace condition alongside eigenvector orthonormality and positive eigenvalues during generation. We characterize the underlying constrained Stiefel manifold and formulate flow matching on it. We further extend LaSFM to property-guided generation, steering samples toward desired graph properties while maintaining these constraints. Experiments demonstrate improved performance on both spectral and graph-level metrics, along with better alignment with target properties.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: CalVLA: Shaping Native Confidence in Vision-Language-Action Policies with Outcome Supervision
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

用结果监督塑造 VLA 策略原生置信度，失败判别 AUROC 0.45→0.73

Can a vision-language-action (VLA) policy signal likely task failure from its own action probabilities? We introduce CalVLA, which shapes native action-token confidence using successful and failed rollouts and an Action-Confidence Alignment (ACal) squared margin-ranking loss. Low-rank adapters update OpenVLA-7B without an auxiliary failure detector. Observations are paired within tasks at similar normalized elapsed times, not necessarily equivalent physical progress. On a held-out test split from 500 LIBERO-10 configurations, adapted confidence achieves a joint failure-discrimination AUROC of $0.7392\pm0.0480$ over three seeds, averaging scores at 130 and 260 steps. Frozen-policy probes reach 0.6146--0.6436, but superiority over the linear probe is statistically inconclusive. For the same confidence summary, AUROC rises from 0.4485 before adaptation to 0.7327 after adaptation. Mean task success decreases from 58% to 55%. These results show improved failure discrimination, not improved control or established safety benefits.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

嵌套双循环递归改进框架，从教学视频挖掘真实工作流扩展计算机使用智能体

Despite recent advances in CUAs, their development remains constrained by the limited diversity, controllability, and reliability of interaction data. Moreover, conventional optimization pipelines lack iterative feedback, while existing recursive improvement approaches often rely on self-generated experiences, limiting ability expansion and yielding diminishing returns. To address these challenges, we introduce CUA-Master, a nested double-loop recursive improvement framework. At the system level, an outer world-data-model flywheel continuously incorporates open-world corpus and leverages evolving model weaknesses to guide subsequent data construction and optimization iterations. At the data level, an inner flywheel couples open-world seeding and autocatalytic propagation. The former mines authentic workflows as seed tasks from instructional videos, and employs visual-semantic dual-path trajectory reconstruction; The latter transforms these seeds into reusable primitives for controllable synthesis of diverse, complex, and verifiable tasks. item.title: BLPO: Beyond-Local Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

跨任务共享任务进度优势估计的长程 LLM agent 策略优化

Long-horizon tasks require large language model (LLM) agents to coordinate interdependent actions, a capability central to automating complex workflows. Stepwise group-based reinforcement learning provides finer credit than trajectory-level supervision, but reliable comparisons must account for differences in interaction history. Enforcing this consistency within the limited rollouts of each task can leave insufficient support for estimating action preferences. We propose Beyond-Local Policy Optimization (BLPO), which estimates task-progress advantages from experience shared across tasks and training updates. We summarize trajectory prefixes into task-progress states and abstract actions by their function, allowing corresponding decisions from different tasks to contribute to shared estimates. To control bias and noise from heterogeneous tasks, we accumulate context-relative returns in a global memory with balanced aggregation and reliability weighting. These global advantages complement local comparisons over normalized actions and trajectory-level credit without a learned critic or additional rollouts. item.title: AuroraWorld: Structured 4D World Modeling for Exo-to-Ego Video Generation in Robot Manipulation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

从外部视角生成机器人第一视角操作视频的 4D 世界模型

Egocentric observations provide a robot-centric view of manipulation processes, capturing contact interactions and object-state changes that are important for visuomotor policy learning but difficult to observe from external cameras. However, collecting such data at scale remains expensive due to additional hardware requirements and platform-specific deployment costs. Synthesizing egocentric observations from large-scale exocentric manipulation videos provides a scalable alternative. However, existing methods struggle to synthesize physically consistent and policy-relevant egocentric videos under substantial viewpoint transformations, severe occlusions, complex object interactions, and inherently sparse observations from available exocentric viewpoints.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: A generative foundation model for computational brain imaging
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AI)　发布：2026-11-03　分类：论文PDF

BrainGFM：约 130 万 MRI/CT 切片预训练的可重构脑影像生成基础模型，48 项下游任务验证

Computational brain imaging is constrained by a mismatch between increasingly diverse tasks and scarce, heterogeneous clinical data. Although existing brain foundation models transfer pretrained representations, their knowledge remains entangled within model-specific features and fixed architectures. This paper proposes BrainGFM, a generative foundation model that extends knowledge transfer beyond representation reuse through a reusable and reconfigurable brain-imaging prior. By pretraining on a corpus of about 1.3 million MRI and CT slices, BrainGFM supported task-aligned data synthesis for low-data predictive learning and task-adapted post-training for image reconstruction. Across 48 downstream tasks, BrainGFM improved segmentation and classification under limited supervision and achieved high-fidelity image enhancement across heterogeneous imaging conditions. Multicenter clinical validation involving 4,796 stroke patients across two internal and four external centers demonstrated its applicability to three clinically relevant tasks around stroke cohorts. Blinded reader assessments showed that BrainGFM-generated FLAIR images approached acquired FLAIR in overall diagnostic quality…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。
